scope:
Check native identity generation with isolated files and no host network.

Development evidence only: wall-clock independence and final signed-artifact
proof remain separate requirements. This report never enables release caches.

runs.name: clean-first
sandbox_argv:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(import "dyld-support.sb")
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow process-info* (target self))
(allow signal (target self))
(allow file-write-data (subpath "/dev/fd") (literal "/dev/null"))
(allow file-read* file-map-executable (subpath "/System/Library") (subpath "/usr/lib"))
(allow file-read* (literal "/dev/urandom") (literal "/dev/random") (literal "/dev/null"))
(allow file-read* (literal "/private/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf"))
(allow file-read* (subpath "/Users/runner/.dws-native-34011126327-1/dws-identity-environment-_okppmi_/fixture") (subpath "/Users/runner/.dws-native-34011126327-1/dws-identity-environment-_okppmi_/clean-first"))
(allow file-read* file-map-executable (literal "/Users/runner/work/_temp/schema-identity-generator") (literal "/bin/cat") (literal "/usr/bin/curl"))
(allow process-exec (literal "/Users/runner/work/_temp/schema-identity-generator") (literal "/bin/cat") (literal "/usr/bin/curl"))
